entries.name: Kosovo
entries.codeStatus: user-assigned code XK (not in ISO 3166-1 or the pinned tzdb 2026e tables), game map only
entries.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope as game venue maps, with no claims. XK is the widely used user-assigned code for Kosovo (it is the ISO3166-1 tag of OSM relation 2088990). The pinned iso3166.tab and zone1970.tab have no XK row; Kosovo observes the same civil time as the Europe/Belgrade row (CET/CEST), which is the pinned zone1970.tab row RS,BA,HR,ME,MK,SI. Only runs for XK read the two tables with this one row appended; every other country reads the pinned files unchanged.

entries.name: Somaliland
entries.codeStatus: user-assigned code XS (not in ISO 3166-1 or the pinned tzdb 2026e tables), game map only
entries.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope as game venue maps, with no claims. XS is a user-assigned code for the world-map entry Somaliland (OSM relation 3586169, admin_level 3, no ISO3166-1 tag). The pinned tables have no XS row; Somaliland observes East Africa Time like the pinned Africa/Nairobi row (KE,DJ,ER,ET,KM,MG,SO,TZ,UG,YT). Only runs for XS read the two tables with this one row appended.
